data.body_html:
Planning a marbella boat rental weather may 2034 trip? May offers some of the best conditions for chartering a boat on the Costa del Sol. With average air temperatures of 22°C, sea temperatures of 18-20°C, and 9 hours of sunshine daily, it's a prime month for cruising from Puerto Banús to Estepona or Sotogrande. This guide breaks down the weather data, sea conditions, and best boats for your May 2034 charter.

Average Temperatures in May 2034

Daytime highs in Marbella during May reach 26°C, with overnight lows around 18°C. The sea breeze keeps things comfortable, even on the warmest afternoons. Water temperatures hover between 18°C and 20°C — refreshing for a swim but not tropical. For reference, the historic average for May is 22°C, with 2023 recording a high of 28°C on the 20th.

Sea Conditions and Wind

The Mediterranean in May is generally calm. Average wind speeds are 8-12 knots, with the famous Poniente (west) wind bringing clear skies and moderate swell. Mornings are often glassy, ideal for a smooth departure from Puerto Banús. Afternoons see a light sea breeze, perfect for sailing or motoring along the coast. Wave heights rarely exceed 0.5-1m.

Sunshine and Rainfall

May averages 9 hours of direct sunshine per day. Rainfall is low — approximately 20mm spread over 4-5 days, usually as short showers. You can expect 25+ mostly sunny days. UV index is high (7-8), so bring protection. Our boats all have shaded areas, and the flybridge on the Azimut 58 Flybridge offers both sun and shade options.

Best Boats for May Weather

For May's mix of sun and light breeze, a flybridge or open cruiser works well. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, €4,719/4h) offers speed and luxury. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) provides panoramic views and comfort. For a sportier option, the Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax) is a favourite. Smaller groups may prefer the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax, €749/2h) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax, €749/2h).

Where to Go in May

With calm seas, you can explore the entire coast. Popular routes include west to Estepona (10 NM, 30 min) or east to Cabopino (8 NM, 25 min). For a longer day, head to Sotogrande (20 NM, 1 hour) or Cala del Faro for swimming. The sea breeze makes afternoon trips comfortable, while mornings are best for fishing or watersports.

What to Pack for a May Charter

Pack light layers: T-shirts, shorts, a light jacket or fleece for the morning departure. Swimwear, a towel, and a sun hat are essential. The sun is strong, so use SPF 50+ sunscreen. Our charters include soft drinks, beer, wine, and snacks, but you can bring your own food. All boats have coolers and ice.

Booking Advice for May 2034

May is popular, especially weekends. We recommend booking by March 2034. The Mangusta 80 at €4,719 for 4 hours includes a free jet ski. For half-day or full-day trips, Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and IVA. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing on other boats.
